dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Adds concrete expert knowledge not usually in baseline models: encryption must be set at creation, detailed configuration dependency graph, snapshot‑vs‑maintenance window overlap rule, replica promotion priority details, and online‑resharding constraints.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Offers a clear AWS‑specific procedural flow (dependency graph, exact CLI commands, ordering of subnet‑group → security‑group → replication‑group, etc.). One minor generic statement (“check security”) prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a detailed "NEVER" list with concrete pitfalls (e.g., enabling encryption post‑creation, setting AUTH without TLS, multi‑AZ without replicas) and explains why each is dangerous, reflecting experience‑driven warnings.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete (name, description, version, author, license, keywords, tags, dependencies, metadata). Description clearly states WHAT the skill does, WHEN to invoke, and provides activation keywords. No missing fields.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered with quick‑navigation and detailed sections, but the sheer length of some sections (e.g., full command tables) adds cognitive load, preventing a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are gated by a prerequisite checklist, matching the fragility of provisioning resources. Slight over‑specification in some optional flags keeps it from full marks.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (mindset, steps, NEVER, output format). Minor inconsistency in section naming prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: The model output provided no checklist or verdict, violating the strict output contract. An agent could not act on the skill as written, indicating major usability failure.
